title: Jonah and the Salt
premise: Oscar Thackeray, youngest smuggler of the Salt Guild, has spent his life moving contraband through the Thornfell mountains while the guild's old covenant with the dragon-realms quietly rots. When the border wards collapse and the stars vanish in a single night, he learns his guild's founders once bound themselves to the last dragons—and that their betrayal is why the sky is dying. Guided by a disgraced ward-keeper named Sera and an exiled dragon in human guise, Oscar must gather the scattered covenant-stones and confront the guildmaster who sold them for power. In the end, Oscar chooses truth over loyalty to the guild that raised him, reforging the covenant at the cost of the guild itself, and the stars return as dragon-fire spreads across the peaks.
about_author: Felix Almeida is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent six years mapping mountain passes before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about borders—geographic, moral, and otherwise—from a small house at the edge of nowhere.

chapters.title: The Weight of Contraband
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. He runs a moonlit smuggling route through Thornfell, dodging patrols and delivering salt to a dying village, establishing his skill and the guild's quiet desperation. Emotional beat: pride in invisibility masking loneliness.

chapters.title: The Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. The border wards shatter and every star goes out simultaneously; the guild hall erupts in panic as the guildmaster, Corvane, seals the doors. Emotional beat: dread—the world he trusted has broken open.

chapters.title: What the Guild Buried
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. A disgraced ward-keeper arrives seeking the guild's archive, revealing the founders' covenant with the dragons was betrayed generations ago. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance born of shared guilt.

chapters.title: Salt and Ash
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Corvane orders the guild to hoard supplies and abandon the villages; Oscar smuggles food out anyway, defying him for the first time. Emotional beat: first fracture between loyalty and conscience.

chapters.title: The Passenger
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A scarred stranger named Wren hires passage over the pass, then reveals herself as an exiled dragon in mortal form when bandits attack. Emotional beat: awe and terror colliding.

chapters.title: Covenant-Stones
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. She explains the five covenant-stones scattered across the realms must be reunited to rekindle dragon-fire; Wren knows where three lie. Emotional beat: hope arriving disguised as an impossible task.

chapters.title: The Guildmaster's Ledger
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Searching the archive, he finds proof Corvane helped break the wards in exchange for dominion over the darkened lands. Emotional beat: betrayal cutting deeper than any enemy's blade.

chapters.title: Hollow Bridge
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The trio crosses a ruined bridge into the lowlands, where starless night has bred creatures of shadow; Wren burns her dwindling fire to save them. Emotional beat: sacrifice foreshadowing the cost ahead.

chapters.title: The Drowned Chapel
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. They retrieve the first stone from a flooded chapel guarded by a drowned congregation of ghosts who demand a confession. Emotional beat: Oscar admits his complicity in the guild's silence.

chapters.title: Old Friends, New Orders
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Guild hunters catch up; Sera faces her former mentor and must choose sides publicly, wounding him to save Oscar. Emotional beat: found family hardening against the old one.

chapters.title: The Market of Small Mercies
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. In a refugee city, they trade favors for the second stone's location; Oscar reconnects with smuggler contacts who become unexpected allies. Emotional beat: community forming outside guild lines.

chapters.title: Corvane's Gift
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. He offers Oscar full guild inheritance if he surrenders the stones, revealing twisted sincerity—he believes darkness is mercy. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a fatherly face.

chapters.title: Fire in the Deep
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The third stone lies in a dormant volcano; Wren descends alone and returns diminished, her mortality deepening. Emotional beat: love and fear entwined as she weakens.

chapters.title: The Turncoat's Road
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A trusted friend sells their route to Corvane; ambushed, they escape only by burning the smugglers' secret roads forever. Emotional beat: grief for the past, resolve for the future.

chapters.title: Where the Map Ends
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Beyond all mapped territory they find the fourth stone held by a hermit order of star-watchers who test each claimant with their worst memory. Emotional beat: Sera confronting the day she failed her wards.

chapters.title: The Gathering Dark
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Corvane seizes the refugee city, using its people as hostages; Oscar realizes the final confrontation cannot be avoided or won cleanly. Emotional beat: anger transmuting into responsibility.

chapters.title: Four Stones, One Voice
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. United, the stones begin to sing, showing each bearer the original covenant—and the exact moment the founders chose power over promise. Emotional beat: understanding without absolution.

chapters.title: Thornfell Rising
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar leads smugglers, refugees, and ward-keepers back through the mountains to retake the guild hall. Emotional beat: the invisible man becoming a banner others rally to.

chapters.title: The Last Dragon-Fire
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Climax: inside the guild hall, Corvane extinguishes the hearth-flame holding the fifth stone; Wren gives her remaining fire to reignite it, nearly dying. Emotional beat: everything wagered on one guttering light.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Climax resolved: Oscar speaks the covenant aloud, renouncing the guild's secrecy, and the five stones fuse; dragon-fire floods the peaks and stars ignite overhead. Emotional beat: truth outshining loyalty.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Salt Guild
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Corvane, defeated, chooses exile into the dark rather than judgment; the guild formally dissolves, its members free to build something honest. Emotional beat: mourning what deserved to end.

chapters.title: First Light Over Thornfell
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Epilogue: months later, Oscar maps new roads—not for smuggling but for trade and pilgrimage—as Wren's strength returns and the found family gathers at dawn. Emotional beat: quiet, earned peace.
